entry.title: Tower of Hercules
entry.note: +Y up; +Z is the modeled broad landing and entrance-facing elevation, directed northeast (about 59 degrees true); +X faces northwest. The offset staircase/lightning cylinder lies west-northwest of the lantern. The separate narrow northwest podium access is outside this single-landing reconstruction. Signed quadrant is visually reconstructed from inspected north-up map/aerial access and roof layout, not surveyed camera or entrance azimuth. The square map envelope remains 12.7 m versus the published 11.75 m core; no XY stretch. Platform radius, parapet, minor openings, upper-stage allocation and fittings are photo-proportioned. Host terrain-contact Y=0 is a viewer convention, not the 57 m hill elevation or a surveyed tide/vertical datum. Excavated visitor annex, inscription edicule, separate northwest access, interiors and entire park are not included. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
